claims.claim_ar: عبارة «مِنْ دُونِهِ» تفيد الحصر والاستبعاد، أي تقييد الاعتماد بالله دون سواه وإقصاء غيره.
claims.claim_en: The phrase «min dūnihī» expresses exclusion/limitation (hasr/qasr), i.e. restricting reliance to God alone and excluding others.
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting source chunk is primarily a grammatical/exegetical gloss that contains the literal prepositional phrase '(من دون)'; a dedicated classical rhetoric citation linking this specific expression to the rhetorical category would strengthen confidence.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Emphasizes exclusivity of reliance on God and negates legitimacy of other protectors or rivals, reinforcing the addressee's defiance.

warnings: Provided source chunks contain limited direct commentary on S11:55; most chunks are grammatical/exegetical or address other verses. Accordingly, only claims that could be directly tied to exact substrings in the supplied chunks were extracted.

No explicit classical-rhetorical discussions (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, or tafsir-balagha) on the other words/phrases of this ayah were present among the source chunks; further claims would require additional primary rhetoric sources.
